exercises.name: Leg Press
exercises.instructions: Set your feet around shoulder-width on the platform. Lower under control until your knees are comfortably bent, keep your lower back against the pad, then drive the platform away without locking your knees.

exercises.name: Bench Press
exercises.instructions: Plant your feet, keep your upper back tight on the bench, lower the bar toward the mid-chest with control, then press up while keeping your wrists stacked over your elbows.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.instructions: Sit tall with your thighs secured. Pull the bar toward your upper chest by driving your elbows down, pause briefly, then return to the top with a controlled stretch.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
exercises.instructions: Stand tall with a soft bend in your elbows. Raise the dumbbells out to the sides until your arms are around shoulder height, then lower slowly without swinging.

exercises.name: Cable Crunch
exercises.instructions: Kneel in front of the cable and keep the rope near your head. Curl your ribcage toward your pelvis using your abs, then return with control without turning it into a hip hinge.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
exercises.instructions: Keep a slight bend in your knees and push your hips back while the weight travels close to your legs. Stop when you feel a strong hamstring stretch, then drive your hips forward to stand tall.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
exercises.instructions: Set the bench to a moderate incline. Lower the dumbbells beside your upper chest with your elbows slightly tucked, then press up and slightly inward without banging the weights together.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row
exercises.instructions: Sit tall with a neutral spine. Pull the handle toward your lower ribs by driving your elbows behind you, squeeze your back, then extend your arms forward under control.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Biceps Curl
exercises.instructions: Keep your upper arms close to your sides. Curl the dumbbells by bending your elbows, squeeze at the top, then lower fully without using momentum from your hips or shoulders.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.instructions: Hold the weight close to your chest. Sit down between your hips while keeping your whole foot planted and knees tracking over your toes, then stand by driving the floor away.

exercises.name: Machine Shoulder Press
exercises.instructions: Adjust the seat so the handles start around shoulder height. Keep your back against the pad, press overhead smoothly, then lower until your elbows are comfortably below shoulder level.

exercises.name: Face Pull
exercises.instructions: Set the cable around face height. Pull the rope toward your face while separating the ends and keeping your elbows high, squeeze the rear shoulders, then return slowly.

exercises.name: Cable Triceps Pushdown
exercises.instructions: Keep your elbows pinned close to your sides. Extend your elbows until your arms are straight, pause briefly, then let the handle return without allowing your upper arms to drift forward.

exercises.name: Hack Squat
exercises.instructions: Set your feet comfortably on the platform and keep your back supported. Lower with control to a depth you can own, keep your knees tracking with your toes, then drive through your whole foot to stand.

exercises.name: Barbell Hip Thrust
exercises.instructions: Set your upper back against a bench and place the load across your hips. Brace your trunk, drive through your feet and extend your hips until your torso is roughly level, then lower under control without over-arching your lower back.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
exercises.instructions: Place your rear foot on a bench and keep most of your pressure through the front leg. Lower straight down with control, keep the front foot planted, then drive through the front leg to stand.

exercises.name: Lying Leg Curl
exercises.instructions: Line your knees up with the machine pivot and keep your hips down. Curl the pad toward your glutes by bending your knees, squeeze briefly, then lower slowly to a long hamstring position.

exercises.name: Assisted Pull-Up
exercises.instructions: Use enough assistance to keep every rep smooth. Start from a controlled hang, drive your elbows down as you bring your chest toward the handles, then lower under control to full arm extension.

exercises.name: Chest-Supported Dumbbell Row
exercises.instructions: Lie chest-down on a low incline bench. Let the dumbbells hang, pull your elbows back toward your hips without lifting your chest off the pad, squeeze your back, then lower fully.

exercises.name: Cable Chest Fly
exercises.instructions: Set both cables around chest height and step forward into a stable stance. With a soft bend in your elbows, bring your hands together in a wide arc, squeeze your chest, then return slowly to a comfortable stretch.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise
exercises.equipment: Calf raise machine or loaded standing setup
exercises.instructions: Keep your knees softly extended and let your heels descend under control. Rise onto the balls of your feet as high as you comfortably can, pause, then lower slowly instead of bouncing.

exercises.name: Pallof Press
exercises.instructions: Stand side-on to the cable with the handle at your chest. Brace your trunk and press your hands straight forward without letting the cable rotate you, pause, then bring your hands back to your chest.
